message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As a rough estimate:

- **$1 USD ≈ £0.78 GBP** (typical mid‑market rate)

So:

- **$20 USD × 0.78 ≈ £15.60 GBP**

This is a ballpark figure; the exact amount you receive will vary depending on the day’s rate and any fees your bank or service may charge. For the most accurate conversion, check a reliable financial news source or a currency‑conversion website/app at the time you plan to make the transaction.
